sourceNote: NO PRIMARY DATA EXISTS FOR THIS ERA. A dedicated 2026 research pass found no counted pull-rate study for any Diamond & Pearl or Platinum set. The widely repeated '1 Lv.X per box' figure traces to a 2010 PokeBeach forum guide that SELF-DECLARES 'these are estimations, not exact ratios', cites no sample or method anywhere, and was demonstrably revised in response to single-box anecdotes, with its author admitting he averaged rumours to produce the headline numbers. A competing unsourced claim puts Lv.X at ~1:36 packs in early DP improving to ~1:18 later, which CONTRADICTS '1 per box' on a 36-pack box - and neither side has a sample. The rates below (ultra_rare ~0.04/pack for Lv.X, hyper_rare 0.014/pack for gold-star secrets) are the site's own model sitting between those unsourced claims. Regular holos are treated as bulk. PRICE CAVEAT: sealed DP and Platinum boxes trade as vintage collectables well above what their contents support.
